+#### Early customer adoption, AI usage and monetization — November 4 research decision; design only
+
+**Direction, not an activated commercial offer:** With no paying customers, prioritize low-friction first adoption and five genuine design-partner evaluations. Investigate **free-to-explore supported Axiom capabilities + optional, transparent, prepaid AI usage + individually scoped enterprise evaluations**. Keep Axiom's core differentiator governed deployment decisions, human approval, audit and recovery; do not rebrand it as a token reseller. Avoid a prominent intimidating "Pricing" primary navigation item if usability research supports "Get started" or "AI usage", but make exact applicable prices, limitations, refund rules and billing disclosures easy to find *before* any charge. Never imply free production deployments, unrestricted features, unlimited seats, certified enterprise capabilities or a functioning payment flow without real acceptance. Distinguish trial, preview, available and planned features; no dark patterns.
+
+**Mandatory source and economics audit before implementation:** Inventory current Axiom AI SDK/Gateway/provider routes, direct-provider and BYOK paths, model routing/fallbacks, current quote/admission/ledger/settlement contracts, tenants, free/public variants, entitlement checks, database and deployment infrastructure, provider rate cards, and existing customer-facing copy. Preserve existing A7 pricing/quote and security gates: locally verified synthetic request-cost accounting is **not** real qualified billable pricing; canonical quote eligibility is unavailable. Vercel AI SDK is a developer library, not itself the billing provider; confirm actual AI Gateway usage before treating Gateway cost metadata as authoritative. Check Vercel Gateway system-credential charges, BYOK provider charges and fallback separately; Gateway budgets do not necessarily cap BYOK charges. Verify current provider rates and terms at implementation time, not from historical examples. Official research: https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/pricing ; https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/authentication-and-byok/byok ; https://docs.stripe.com/billing/token-billing ; https://stripe.com/blog/where-pricing-is-headed ; competitor references https://www.harness.io/pricing , https://spacelift.io/pricing and https://www.env0.com/pricing . These are research inputs, not validated Axiom implementations or a price commitment.
+
+**Evaluate, do not prematurely fix the business model:** Compare 1.5x, 2x and alternative cost-plus markups, prepaid customer-visible AI credits, actual-model-cost pass-through, customer BYOK, and later hybrid enterprise licensing. For each, model input/output/cached tokens, tool calls, retries, model/provider fallback, non-token fees, payment fees, hosting, database, queue/worker costs, support, fraud, taxes, refunds, currency, idle tenants and gross margin under typical and high-percentile workloads. 2x is a **test hypothesis only**, not a published rate, authorized charge, guaranteed margin or promise of perpetual free governance. Collect willingness-to-pay and operational feedback from design partners before final selection; allow enterprise on-prem, SLA/support, deployment-scale and procurement costs to be evaluated independently of AI usage. Preserve optional future enterprise revenue without imposing per-seat fees at initial evaluation.
+
+**Safe implementation design and acceptance gates:** Propose a versioned tenant-scoped rate card, clear units and conversion examples, deterministic immutable usage ledger, unique request/run idempotency keys, correct cost attribution for model/provider/input/output/cached tokens and extras, quote-before-execution with conservative budget reservation and final reconciliation, hard per-tenant and per-user limits with deny-default on unavailable prices, and visible balances/history/export. Specify explicit policies for failed/partial/streamed responses, retries, duplicate events, cached answers, internal/demo usage, refunds, disputes, corrections, late events and provider-side fallback; prevent double billing and cross-tenant leakage. Reconcile independently against provider invoices and billing-system meters; test concurrent spending, adversarial usage, crash/replay, account cancellation, provider changes, refunds and ledger integrity in isolated synthetic fixtures. Use Stripe/Metronome or another billing service only after vendor/security/fee/license evaluation and explicit approval; no account connection, keys, payment method, purchases, real charges, migrations, production switches or customer-facing promise by this instruction.
+
+**Two-workstream delivery:** Workstream A/A7 designs accurate, secure metering, admission and entitlement boundaries without changing production billing or Governance authority. Workstream B/B2 drafts original "Start with Axiom" / "AI usage" / "Enterprise evaluation" messaging and UX with honest feature-availability labels; B6 verifies keyboard/mobile/accessibility, understandable disclosures and end-to-end simulated checkout/cancellation/refund paths. C4 retains future founder financial reporting scope. Track a decision matrix, cost scenarios, real-source evidence, risks and unresolved approvals in the current execution board; no parent completion from research alone. Preserve A1–A9, B1–B6 and C1–C6 scope and critical A2 Governance priority. No deployment, external publication, payment processing or change to live pricing until a separate explicit reviewed decision.
+
 #### Premium visual assets and original creative direction
 
 During the existing research of Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Harness.io, and Grok, study their website imagery, hero visuals, product illustrations, animations, interactive diagrams, screenshots, backgrounds, typography, spacing, and visual storytelling. Identify what makes each experience premium and where Axiom can deliver a more polished, distinctive result. Think deeply about which visuals would genuinely improve Axiom's website, then design and implement original, production-quality assets where appropriate—including custom product illustrations, sophisticated workflow visualizations, subtle motion, interactive deployment/governance diagrams, and authentic application screenshots. Make Axiom feel exceptionally clean, minimal, powerful, modern, and enterprise-grade, with strong visual hierarchy and restrained use of its existing brand colors. Avoid unnecessary decorative images, generic AI-generated artwork, animated, clutter, excessive animations, and anything that compromises performance or accessibility. **Do not copy, trace, reproduce, or reuse competitors' copyrighted images, illustrations, animations, layouts, or branding.** Use their work only to understand quality standards and design principles. Every visual must serve a clear product purpose, accurately represent Axiom's verified capabilities, and feel uniquely Axiom. Implement improvements incrementally, show the updated website locally at meaningful milestones, and continue the existing prioritized execution plan without restarting, pausing, or duplicating completed work.
